title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Rate Schedule for a Resumption Deposit
content:
**Finance office note, resumption deposits — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The resumption deposit schedule follows the agreement's rate notice (notice period 60 days; current schedule effective 1 July 2026).

- A delivery date is recorded, the notice had run its 60 days by the conversion date recorded on the agreement, and that date falls on or after 1 July 2026: **the current private pay schedule**.
- A delivery date is recorded and that is not so: **the preceding schedule**.
- No delivery date is recorded: **the schedule in effect on the agreement's admission date** — current for an admission on or after 1 July 2026, preceding otherwise.

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).** Notice delivered 50 days before the recorded conversion date: preceding. No notice recorded and an admission before 1 July 2026: preceding; admission on or after that date: current.
